conceptZh: 圓桶玩具海盜與太空人玩偶為了搶一根堅硬的鋼鐵雙槓展開拔河，不聽話的玩具鸚鵡一屁股坐上海盜鼻頭害兩人彈飛跌坐，鬆開的鋼條與彎鉤瞬間彈合立起成堅硬的「剛」字，兩人還學金剛捶胸威風比力氣。
object: heavy steel barbell frame and twin iron anchor rods
morph: A heavy steel barbell frame and curved anchor hooks tugged in a tug-of-war snap upright and lock together into the left ridged frame 岡 and right vertical knife radical 刂 of the character 剛.
creativeAngle: 以「拔河（Tug-of-War）」肢體喜劇結合「剛」的堅硬本義與詞語「金剛」：圓桶玩具海盜與漂浮太空人玩偶死命拉扯堅硬鋼鐵槓鈴，搭配不合作鸚鵡亂停鼻頭的搞笑突發狀況，讓彈開的剛硬鐵件直接組合成左「岡」右「刂」結構清晰的「剛」字，並在唸出「金剛」時讓角色與彈出的發條小金剛一起捶胸耍帥，全程節奏緊湊、零說教。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D cartoon animation on a clean, warm cream-colored playroom stage with soft matte lighting and zero background clutter. At 0.0s, a barrel-shaped wooden toy pirate on the left and a bouncy astronaut toy in a round fishbowl helmet on the right both grab opposite ends of a gleaming, rigid cobalt-blue steel frame bar resting center stage, while a grumpy green toy parrot perches on the pirate's hat refusing to budge. At 1.2s, as a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin speaks the first utterance of "剛、剛、金剛 (ㄍㄤ、ㄍㄤ、ㄐㄧㄣ ㄍㄤ)"—reading those exact Zhuyin syllables slowly and distinctly with clear tones—both toys plant their boots and yank hard in a tug-of-war; their cheeks puff bright red, the pirate's boots skid across the floor, and the astronaut's feet accidentally float up horizontal as he pulls in mid-air. At 2.6s, the uncooperative toy parrot hops straight onto the straining pirate's nose, blocking his eyes; startled, both tuggers lose their grip at 3.4s with a comical cartoon BOING and tumble backward onto their bottoms at the far left and right edges, spinning with dizzy grins. Between 3.6s and 5.0s, as the voice speaks the second "剛 (ㄍㄤ)", the released heavy cobalt-blue steel pieces spring upward into the center and lock with a solid metallic clack into the exact Traditional Chinese character "剛", occupying 70% of the frame height in a saturated solid cobalt-blue color: the left component "岡" clearly shows its tall outer three-sided frame "冂", the inner two short top strokes and horizontal bar "丷 + 一", and the nested three-peaked "山" at its base, while the right component "刂" stands cleanly beside it with a short vertical stroke and a longer vertical hooked stroke. From 5.0s to 8.0s, the centered glyph "剛" holds completely still and razor-sharp for a full 3-second hold. At 5.8s, right as the voice clearly pronounces "金剛 (ㄐㄧㄣ ㄍㄤ)", a tiny wind-up toy gorilla pops up beside the pirate's boot, and the pirate, the floating astronaut, and the little toy gorilla all puff out their chests and drum their fists against their chests in a mighty, joyful Kong pose away from the strokes. Keep only the single target glyph on screen with no subtitles, watermarks, or extra text, and keep background sound effects soft under the voice.
